blocks.text: With respect to the physical states of the reactants and products there are two types of chemical equilibrium: homogeneous, in which all species are in the same phase, and heterogeneous, in which they are in more than one phase. The next topic gives examples of each.

blocks.prompt: Classify the equilibria 2NO2(g) giving N2O4(g) and Fe3O4(s) + 4H2(g) giving 3Fe(s) + 4H2O(g) as homogeneous or heterogeneous.
blocks.explanation: The first is homogeneous, all gases. The second is heterogeneous, with solids and gases together.

items: Two types by phase: homogeneous (one phase) and heterogeneous (more than one phase).
